summary: Pinnacle West Capital Corporation filed a prospectus supplement for a public offering of $500 million 4.650% Senior Notes due 2029. The notes are priced at 99.915% of par, offering proceeds of $497.825 million before expenses. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the notes mature on June 1, 2029. The company may redeem the notes under certain conditions. Underwriters include MUFG, TD Securities, Truist Securities, and Wells Fargo Securities. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
